channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to South Florida roads
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans traveled at least 50 miles from home this holiday weekend, with 61.4 million making the trip by car, creating heavy traffic on the Florida Turnpike and other South Florida roads.

item.title: Juno Beach residents push for fence replacement at JB-7 beach access as town weighs budget impact
item.description: A missing fence at the JB-7 public beach access point is causing conflict between Colony Condos residents and beachgoers, with a replacement potentially costing the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, marking the only Florida city selected this year.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive 'A' rating from state with record graduation rate
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an 'A' rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 143 district-operated schools rated A or B and a record-setting 93.5% graduation rate.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook post
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year following controversial social media .

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% this year, ground beef and strawberries hit hardest
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Port St. Lucie expands Midway Road, adds Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved giving 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike at Midway Road as part of a $95 million widening project.

item.title: Glydways proposes elevated self-driving transit connecting West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: A California-based company will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of autonomous vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach is celebrating after being named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, the only Florida city selected this year.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce is transforming the city into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain who once lived in the historic Crain Estate and offering tours and artist residencies.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue 2 after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, saved by marine deputies and the life-saving decision to wear life jackets.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent this year, ground beef and buns up sharply
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation, doubling boat slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program finished last season with a 10-2 record and a district title, but a second-round playoff exit has motivated the team to aim higher for the 2026 fall season. item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.title: North Palm Beach hosts Fourth of July fireworks and pool party at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors celebrated Independence Day with family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club on July 4.

item.title: U.S. men's soccer team faces Belgium Monday after controversial red card
item.description: The United States men's national team takes the field Monday night against Belgium in the World Cup Round of 16 after earning their first knockout stage victory since 2002.

item.title: Supreme Court rules states may count absentee ballots received after Election Day
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled 5-4 that states may count absentee ballots postmarked by Election Day but received afterward, providing clarity to Florida and other states with grace period laws.
